purpose: Describe an outward sign of a feeling or state.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + げ; selected V stems + げ
The child looked toward the entrance anxiously.
She looked as though she wanted to say something.
The cat is asleep with a contented expression.
formation: い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + げ; selected V stems + げ
restrictions: Attaches to selected words such as 悲しげ, 不安げ, and 言いたげ.
mistake: Do not freely attach げ to every adjective or noun.
